::: {#exm-append}
#### Appending `'(1 2)` and `'(3)`

In Racket, the definition of append (@def-append) is

```racket
(define (app L M)
  (if (empty? L)
      M
      (cons (first L) (app (rest L) M))))
```

The recursion takes `L` apart and leaves `M` alone:

```text
(app '(1 2) '(3))
= (cons 1 (app '(2) '(3)))
= (cons 1 (cons 2 (app '() '(3))))
= (cons 1 (cons 2 '(3)))
= '(1 2 3)
```

Racket's built-in `append` gives the same values.

:::
